cmd_sureli_info: Automatically captures and saves single-use timed media.
cmd_stt_info: Transcribes voice messages or audio files

cmd_tg_info: Downloads the Telegram media message or link and sends it to the Backup group.
cmd_whois_info: Performs detailed identity and profile analysis about the user.
cmd_ocr_info: Reads text from the responded image (OCR).
cmd_otomesaj_info: Opens the automatic scheduled message management panel.
